items.statement: Sales growth of 50% YoY in H1 FY26, PAT growth of 33% YoY
items.quote: we have achieved growth of more than 50% in sales with respect to the corresponding duration last year. As far as the PAT is concerned, we have achieved a growth of 33% with respect to the duration in the last year.

items.statement: No new capex planned; only consolidation of existing expansions
items.quote: We are not doing any Capex expansion as of now. We are just consolidating what we have done in recent months and last year.

items.statement: Export margins 4-5% higher than domestic; working capital cycle better due to LCs/advances
items.quote: The margins are expected to be better by at least 4 or 5%. ... The working capital is better because all our exports are against LCS which can be discounted or against an advance.
